_note: The fleet declaration: which projects this registry is connected to, which machines each is checked out on, and its path RELATIVE to that machine's root. Portable by construction - no user names, no drive letters, no absolute paths - which is why this file is COMMITTED where its predecessor (.projects.local.json) was hidden. The machine-specific half is .machine.local.json (gitignored): a machine name, the root the paths below hang off, and the contributor id. Domains are NOT here on purpose - every project declares its own in its .ai/manifest.yaml (knowledge.domains), and a second copy is how the first one goes stale.
